about: Expected results of tests/workers/scenarios.mjs for the PATCHED rebrowser-puppeteer-core. Unpatched upstream must pass every scenario (else the run is reported as broken). A scenario listed in allowFail may fail; any other failure is a new regression and fails the run. Add an entry only with a reason and an issue link; never to hide a regression.
evidence: Measured 2026-10-08 on Chrome 155: rebrowser-puppeteer-core 24.8.1 and the 25.13.0 port gave identical results (default 20/22, alwaysIsolated 17/22); re-confirmed on the 25.14.0 build on Chrome 155.0.8059.39 (default 20/22, alwaysIsolated 17/22). Unpatched puppeteer-core passed 22/22, and so did the patch with REBROWSER_PATCHES_RUNTIME_FIX_MODE=0.

allowFail.reason: page.waitForFunction() started before a navigation never resolves after it; inherent to the addBinding approach, also present in 24.8.1, passes with the patch off (mode 0)
page.exposeFunction() bindings are not callable from the page without Runtime.enable; also present in 24.8.1, passes with the patch off (mode 0)

alwaysIsolated: reading a same-origin child frame times out (waitForSelector/contentFrame/evaluate never settles); the cross-site OOPIF case works. Present in the 24.8.1 release and in the 25.13.0 and 25.14.0 ports (same TIMEOUT), so inherent to the current alwaysIsolated implementation, not a port regression
alwaysIsolated runs every evaluate() in an isolated world, so page JS globals (window.pageVar) are invisible; documented mode semantics
alwaysIsolated rejects web workers: '[rebrowser-patches] web workers are not supported in alwaysIsolated mode'
